high_level_description: The image is a detailed pencil sketch of a dress displayed on a mannequin. The dress features a halter neckline with thin straps and a fitted bodice that transitions into a full, flowing skirt. The design includes a gathered waistband that cinches the fabric, creating a dramatic silhouette. The sketch is highly detailed, showcasing the texture and folds of the fabric. In the background, there are additional sketches of different dress designs, suggesting a fashion design process or a collection of dress ideas.
